plan.major: Computer Science + Cyber Technology (Combined BSCS/MSCT, Cybersecurity Concentration)
plan.notes: Official Plan of Study Grid for the combined Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Master of Science in Cyber Technology (Cybersecurity concentration, Applied Project track) from the current Clayton State University catalog (current catalog page; 2025-2026 archive links to the same department pages). Years 1-3 are the undergraduate BSCS course requirements (94 cr); the page states 'Students will complete the course requirements for undergraduate BSCS' for Freshman-Junior standing. Blank 3-cr cells in the senior/fifth-year grids are transcribed as Major Concentration / graduate elective placeholders (the 2023-2024 archive version of this grid labels these cells 'Major Concentration'). Semester sums verified against printed totals (16/15/15/16/16/16/15/12/12/12); total 145 = 94+27+24. CSCI 5701 and CSCI 5317 are dual-credit (count toward both degrees). Retrieved 2026-10-09.
